content.heading: Official Update at a Glance
paragraphs: The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has announced 3,548 graduate-level Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC) vacancies under CEN 06/2026, as confirmed by the Press Information Bureau (PIB) on 11 October 2026. Applications opened on 8 October 2026 and the deadline is 6 November 2026 at 23:59. The four post categories are: Goods Manager (2,750 posts), Senior Clerk-cum-Typist (371 posts), Junior Clerk-cum-Typist (300 posts), and Commercial-cum-Ticket Supervisor (127 posts). Starting salaries range from ₹29,200 to ₹35,400 per month under the 7th Pay Commission. Eligibility requires a recognized university degree; the notified age limit is 18–33 years as of 1 January 2027, with relaxations for reserved categories. Selection involves a two-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), document verification, and medical examination. Candidates must apply via the official portal https://www.rrbapply.gov.in and consult the detailed notification on RRB websites for post-specific criteria.

This recruitment affects final-year and recent graduate job-seekers across India, particularly those seeking entry-level roles in railway operations, commerce, accounts, and administration. The large volume of vacancies provides significant opportunities, but the two-stage CBT process and strict deadline require early preparation. Applicants should verify their eligibility against post-specific criteria before applying, as errors may lead to rejection. The application correction window (9–18 November 2026) allows limited amendments, but candidates must ensure accuracy at submission.
points: Deadline: Apply online by 6 November 2026, 23:59; fee payment closes 8 November 2026.
Post distribution: 2,750 Goods Manager, 371 Senior Clerk-cum-Typist, 300 Junior Clerk-cum-Typist, 127 Commercial-cum-Ticket Supervisor.
Age & eligibility: 18–33 years as of 1 January 2027; degree required; relaxations per CEN 06/2026 rules.

content.heading: Why This Development Matters

Applications opened on 8 October 2026 and close on 6 November 2026 at 23:59. Selection involves a two-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), document verification, and medical examination, with a computer-based typing skill test (CBTST) waived for Junior and Senior Clerk posts but basic computer proficiency expected.

This recruitment affects aspiring graduates seeking stable central government employment in Indian Railways, particularly those from economically disadvantaged and reserved categories who benefit from age relaxation and fee concessions. The vacancies span commercial, operational, and administrative domains, offering entry-level career pathways into one of the country's largest public sector organisations. However, the two-stage CBT structure and document verification stages may delay appointment, and the CBTST exemption does not eliminate the need for basic typing and computer skills, which are assessed post-recruitment.

Practical implications include a structured application window of 29 days, a non-refundable examination fee with provisions for SC/ST/PwD waivers, and salary scales starting at Level 5 (₹29,200) or Level 6 (₹35,400) per the 7th CPC. Applicants must rely on official RRB portals—rrb.indianrailways.gov.in and rrbapply.gov.in—for authentic notifications and updates, as misinformation on unofficial platforms could lead to missed deadlines or ineligible applications.

content.heading: Official Update at a Glance
paragraphs: The 94th Fit India Sunday Cycle event will be held on 11 October 2026 in Varanasi, led by Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya. The cycle rally begins at 6:00 AM from Namo Ghat and concludes at the Dr. Sampurnanand Sanskrit University Diwas Mandap. The event carries the theme "Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat" and aims to promote active lifestyles and drug-free living among youth and citizens.

Participation will include Asian Games medalists from the 2026 Ichi-Nagoa Games, including Parul Choudhary (athletics), Raj Kumar Pal (hockey), and other contingents. Supplementary activities at Namo Ghat will include yoga sessions, Zumba, and interactive engagements, organized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in collaboration with the Cycling Federation of India, Rahgiri Foundation, and My Bharat.
